title: Verify backups by restoring them
body:
integrity_check passes on files that cannot be opened by the current schema version.

- After each backup, restore it into a temporary directory, open it with the store and run a fixed set of read queries (count briefs, tasks, messages).
- A failing restore marks the backup `verified:false`, raises an owner decision of kind `backup` and keeps the previous good backup out of retention pruning.
- GET /api/v1/backups shows `restored_at` and `restore_error`.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server; internal/backup runs VACUUM INTO and retention, internal/decisions builds the owner inbox

requirements.title: Restore each backup into a temporary directory and run read queries
Raise a backup decision and protect the last good backup from pruning
Expose restored_at and restore_error in GET /api/v1/backups
